title: Kagerou's Reason
summary: Kagerou finds you alone and tells you why.

lines: Alone, {name}? Your sensei sends children out and lets them walk the road by themselves.
She trusted me too. Did she ever tell you why they threw me out?
A training accident. My fire, a friend's arm. Forty stitches. The academy decided I was too strong to be safe.
The Nue can't be held by anyone careful. It needs someone who isn't afraid of his own strength.
It needs someone who isn't afraid of hurting people. That's not the same thing.
...Then show me the difference. Fire only. No tricks.

beats.taunt: Fire only. Like the old days.

phases.say: Still standing? Then wind, just this once.

lines: You hold back. Every strike, you hold back. And you still win.
It changes nothing. New moon, the Shrine of the Five Winds. Bring the scroll, or I break the seal without it. Without the scroll the Nue won't be bound. It'll be free.
He told me about the accident.
I never blamed him. The academy did, and I let them. I should have fought them harder.
Tomorrow night we finish this. And I'll teach you the one technique in that scroll no one has used in a hundred years.
